signature_info.description: Windows To Go Startup Options Command Line Tool

attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (console) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The binary is the "Portable Workspace Launcher Command-Line Tool" (pwlauncher.exe), a legitimate Microsoft utility for managing the Windows To Go feature. Its functionality includes checking for elevated privileges, querying group policy settings from the registry key `HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\PortableOperatingSystem`, and interacting with the `IPortableWorkspaceLauncher` COM object. It also creates WPP diagnostic trace logs (e.g., `pwlauncher.exe-WPPLog-....etl`) in the temp directory. All observed behaviors are consistent with a benign system tool.
